newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks dip, led down by cement and banks.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks dip, led down by cement and banks.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 13 Reuter - Colombian stocks dipped in sluggish trade, led lower by cement and banks, brokers said.
Bogota's fell 0.46 percent to 1,167.56 amid a 2 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED index was down 0.52 percent at 17,703.2 amid a 1.6 billion peso volume.
"Expectation about shares declined, particularly because of the smaller than expected cut in interest rates last week," one Medellin broker said.
Last Tuesday the board of directors of the central bank cut 1 percentage point from its overnight, 30-day and 90-day interest rates.
Cement manufacturer Cemento Argos led the falls. It closed down 2.96 percent to 8,830 in Bogota and down 2.54 percent to the same price in Medellin.

Banco de Bogota fell 1.09 percent to 6,800 in Bogota and 1.45 percent to the same price in Medellin. Banco Ganadero, the country's largest bank in terms of assets, dipped 0.26 percent to 371 in Bogota and 0.8 percent to 372.

The biggest gainer of the day in Bogota was reinsurance company Reaseguradora de Colombia SA, the largest of its kind in the country. It was up 17 percent to 5,000 in Bogota but was not traded in Medellin.
Supermarket chain Carulla gained 4.12 percent to close at 4,165 in Bogota. It was not traded in Medellin.
